| **Textbook** | [Volume III: Agentic Machine Learning Systems](https://mlsysbook.ai/vol3/), a working draft |
| **Prerequisites** | Applied experience with large language models, and systems programming |
| **Format** | A draft plan for a 16-week semester or a 10-week quarter |
| **Materials** | [Slides](https://mlsysbook.ai/slides/vol3.html) |

## Description {#description}

Students study the systems that run AI agents: models that plan over many steps,
keep memory across them, call tools, and recover when a step fails. Volume III
covers these systems in twenty chapters, grouped into seven parts.

## Reading schedule {#schedule}

These materials are still in preparation for teaching in the next semester or year, so they will change as the course takes shape.

::: {.panel-tabset}

## Status {#status}

The course has not yet been taught, and it has no labs or offering yet. The schedule is a draft that follows the chapter order of Volume III.
